method_note: Context Fabric retrieves the references, Hebrew forms, verse text, morphology, and syntax. The contextual frames, phrase boundaries, translations, and explanatory notes below are researcher-supplied close readings; they are not BHSA features or values returned by MCP.
translation_note: The English phrases are deliberately close working translations, not quotations from a published Bible. The collective noun טף is rendered as 'little ones', 'small children', or 'household dependants' according to the local syntax. 'Dependants' is used where טף functions as a household aggregate and may include more than young children. Square brackets mark words supplied for readable English.
revision_note: The earlier three-frame scheme placed movement, settlement, and dependent care in one group. The 2026-08-07 review separates material provision and survival as a fourth frame, adds a narrower context_detail, and moves Jeremiah 41:16 from movement to conflict/captivity because the verse describes people recovered from a captor.
validation_rule: Every retrieved טף reference must occur exactly once. Its mapped Hebrew phrase, after removal of pointing and cantillation, must occur in the retrieved BHSA verse. An omitted, duplicated, unexpected, or textually mismatched reference stops the notebook.

frame_definitions.conflict, captivity, or lethal judgment: The little ones are threatened, captured, recovered from capture, treated as spoil, killed, spared after combat, or exposed to human or divine lethal judgment.
frame_definitions.household movement, displacement, or pro: The little ones or household dependants travel, are transported, remain behind, occupy protected settlements, form part of a displaced civilian population, or require protection on a journey.
frame_definitions.household provision or survival: Food, continued life, or material support for the little ones is the dominant local concern.
frame_definitions.covenant, cultic, or administrative incl: The little ones are expressly included in covenant standing, public Torah hearing, communal worship, or cultic-administrative registration. The label does not imply that every verse describes an assembly event.

occurrences.context_detail: capture and plunder after the massacre at Shechem
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ואת־כל־טפם ואת־נשיהם שבו
occurrences.working_translation: and they took captive all their little ones and their wives
occurrences.classification_note: The finite verb שבו, 'they took captive', directly governs the little ones and wives.

occurrences.context_detail: a journey undertaken so that the household may survive famine
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ונחיה ולא נמות גם־אנחנו גם־אתה גם־טפנו
occurrences.working_translation: so that we may live and not die—we, you, and our little ones
occurrences.classification_note: Travel is proposed, but the clause itself climaxes in the survival of the whole household, including the little ones.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: state-assisted household migration to Egypt
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: קחו־לכם מארץ מצרים עגלות לטפכם ולנשיכם
occurrences.working_translation: take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and your wives
occurrences.classification_note: The wagons are expressly provided to transport the little ones and wives.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: household migration from Canaan to Egypt
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וישאו בני־ישראל את־יעקב אביהם ואת־טפם ואת־נשיהם בעגלות
occurrences.working_translation: the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, their little ones, and their wives in the wagons
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones are named among those physically transported in the migration.

occurrences.context_detail: food allocation according to household need
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ויכלכל יוסף את־אביו ואת־אחיו ואת כל־בית אביו לחם לפי הטף
occurrences.working_translation: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and his father's whole household with food according to the number and needs of the dependants
occurrences.classification_note: לפי הטף is literally 'according to the mouth of the טף'; in context it measures household food by the number or needs of its dependants.

occurrences.context_detail: food retained from the harvest for household consumption
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ולאכלכם ולאשר בבתיכם ולאכל לטפכם
occurrences.working_translation: for your food, for those in your households, and for your little ones to eat
occurrences.classification_note: The infinitive לאכל makes consumption by the little ones the immediate function.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: dependants left in Goshen during the funeral journey
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: רק טפם וצאנם ובקרם עזבו בארץ גשן
occurrences.working_translation: they left only their little ones, flocks, and herds in the land of Goshen
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones remain in the settled place while the adults travel to Canaan.

occurrences.context_detail: Joseph's promise of continuing material support
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: אנכי אכלכל אתכם ואת־טפכם
occurrences.working_translation: I myself will provide for you and your little ones
occurrences.classification_note: The verb אכלכל, 'I will provide', directly governs the brothers and their little ones.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: Pharaoh's sarcastic rejection of a departure with dependants
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: יהי כן יהוה עמכם כאשר אשלח אתכם ואת־טפכם
occurrences.working_translation: May YHWH indeed be with you if I ever let you and your household dependants go
occurrences.classification_note: The issue is who may leave Egypt; טף summarizes the dependent household members included in the proposed departure.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: permission for dependants to depart while livestock is retained
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: רק צאנכם ובקרכם יצג גם־טפכם ילך עמכם
occurrences.working_translation: only your flocks and herds must remain; your household dependants may also go with you
occurrences.classification_note: The verb ילך and prepositional phrase עמכם make accompanied movement explicit.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: the exodus population counted apart from adult men
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: כשש־מאות אלף רגלי הגברים לבד מטף
occurrences.working_translation: about six hundred thousand adult men on foot, apart from the household dependants
occurrences.classification_note: Because הגברים counts the adult men, מטף most naturally covers the accompanying dependent population rather than one precise age band.

occurrences.context_detail: feared capture during attempted conquest
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: נשינו וטפנו יהיו לבז
occurrences.working_translation: our wives and our little ones will become plunder
occurrences.classification_note: The feared predicate יהיו לבז, 'will become plunder', determines the primary frame.

occurrences.context_detail: divine reversal of the feared capture
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וטפכם אשר אמרתם לבז יהיה והביאתי אתם
occurrences.working_translation: your little ones, whom you said would become plunder—I will bring them in
occurrences.classification_note: The verse reverses the threat of capture, but לבז still supplies the local contrast and therefore the primary frame.

occurrences.context_detail: households exposed to the judgment of Korah's company
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ודתן ואבירם יצאו נצבים פתח אהליהם ונשיהם ובניהם וטפם
occurrences.working_translation: Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrances of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little ones
occurrences.classification_note: The list locates the little ones within households about to be overtaken by divine judgment; it is not a neutral assembly.

occurrences.context_detail: capture of Midian's civilian population
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וישבו בני־ישראל את־נשי מדין ואת־טפם
occurrences.working_translation: the Israelites took captive the women of Midian and their little ones
occurrences.classification_note: The verb וישבו, 'they took captive', directly governs both groups.

occurrences.context_detail: order to kill male children among the captives
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: הרגו כל־זכר בטף
occurrences.taph_rendering: the male children among the little ones
occurrences.working_translation: kill every male among the little ones
occurrences.classification_note: The phrase זכר בטף explicitly selects the male subset within the collective טף.

occurrences.context_detail: order to spare female children among the captives
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וכל הטף בנשים אשר לא־ידעו משכב זכר החיו לכם
occurrences.taph_rendering: the female children among the little ones
occurrences.working_translation: but all the female children among the little ones who have not known sexual relations with a male—keep alive for yourselves
occurrences.classification_note: The phrase הטף בנשים selects the female subset of טף and contrasts their survival with the killing ordered in the preceding verse.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: settlements prepared for dependants east of the Jordan
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: גדרת צאן נבנה למקננו פה וערים לטפנו
occurrences.working_translation: we will build sheepfolds here for our livestock and towns for our household dependants
occurrences.classification_note: The towns provide settled protection while the fighting men cross the Jordan.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: protected residence during the Transjordanian military campaign
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וישב טפנו בערי המבצר מפני ישבי הארץ
occurrences.working_translation: our household dependants will remain in the fortified towns because of the inhabitants of the land
occurrences.classification_note: The verbs and location describe noncombatants remaining under protection while the armed men depart.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: towns built for dependants before military departure
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: בנו־לכם ערים לטפכם וגדרת לצנאכם
occurrences.working_translation: build towns for your household dependants and enclosures for your flocks
occurrences.classification_note: This instruction repeats the settlement arrangement of Numbers 32:16–17.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: little ones and wives left in the Gileadite towns
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: טפנו נשינו מקננו וכל־בהמתנו יהיו־שם בערי הגלעד
occurrences.working_translation: our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain there in the towns of Gilead
occurrences.classification_note: Here wives are listed separately, so 'little ones' is more precise than the broader 'dependants'.

occurrences.context_detail: reversal of the wilderness generation's fear of capture
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וטפכם אשר אמרתם לבז יהיה ובניכם אשר לא־ידעו היום טוב ורע המה יבאו שמה
occurrences.working_translation: your little ones, whom you said would become plunder, and your sons who today do not know good from evil—they will enter there
occurrences.classification_note: The verse recalls the threatened-plunder formula while promising the younger generation entry into the land.

occurrences.context_detail: the population of Sihon's towns placed under the ban
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ונחרם את־כל־עיר מתם והנשים והטף לא השארנו שריד
occurrences.working_translation: we put every town under the ban—men, women, and little ones; we left no survivor
occurrences.classification_note: The verb ונחרם and the statement that no survivor remained make this a case of lethal conquest, not merely population movement.

occurrences.context_detail: the population of Og's towns placed under the ban
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: החרם כל־עיר מתם הנשים והטף
occurrences.working_translation: putting every town under the ban—men, women, and little ones
occurrences.classification_note: As in Deuteronomy 2:34, טף occurs inside the population formula governed by החרם.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: families remaining in Transjordan while the fighting men cross
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: רק נשיכם וטפכם ומקנכם ידעתי כי־מקנה רב לכם ישבו בעריכם אשר נתתי לכם
occurrences.working_translation: only your wives, your little ones, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—shall remain in the towns that I have given you
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones are part of the noncombatant household population that remains settled.

occurrences.context_detail: women and little ones treated as spoil after a city's defeat
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: רק הנשים והטף והבהמה וכל אשר יהיה בעיר כל־שללה תבז לך
occurrences.working_translation: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and everything in the city—all its spoil—you may take as plunder
occurrences.classification_note: The rule expressly places the little ones within the captured population and spoil of war.

occurrences.context_detail: the covenant community standing before YHWH
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: טפכם נשיכם וגרך אשר בקרב מחניך
occurrences.working_translation: your little ones, your wives, and your resident alien who is within your camp
occurrences.classification_note: The verse continues the list of those standing before YHWH to enter the covenant; טף is part of the covenant public.

occurrences.context_detail: the septennial public reading of Torah
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: הקהל את־העם האנשים והנשים והטף וגרך אשר בשעריך למען ישמעו ולמען ילמדו
occurrences.working_translation: assemble the people—the men, the women, the little ones, and your resident alien within your gates—so that they may hear and so that they may learn
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones are grammatically part of the object of הקהל and of the plural audience for the purpose clauses.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: families remaining in Transjordan while warriors cross
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: נשיכם טפכם ומקניכם ישבו בארץ אשר נתן לכם משה בעבר הירדן
occurrences.working_translation: your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall remain in the land Moses gave you beyond the Jordan
occurrences.classification_note: The verse restates the Transjordanian division between settled households and crossing warriors.

occurrences.context_detail: public Torah reading before the entire assembly
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: נגד כל־קהל ישראל והנשים והטף והגר ההלך בקרבם
occurrences.working_translation: before the whole assembly of Israel, including the women, the little ones, and the resident alien who lived among them
occurrences.classification_note: The phrase identifies the little ones as present within the audience before whom Joshua reads Moses' command.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: dependants positioned at the front of a migrating convoy
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וישימו את־הטף ואת־המקנה ואת־הכבודה לפניהם
occurrences.working_translation: they placed the little ones, the livestock, and the goods ahead of them
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones' position within the moving convoy is the immediate narrative concern.

occurrences.context_detail: an ordered punitive massacre at Jabesh-gilead
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: לכו והכיתם את־יושבי יבש גלעד לפי־חרב והנשים והטף
occurrences.working_translation: go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, including the women and the little ones
occurrences.classification_note: Women and little ones fall within the stated scope of the lethal command.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: Ittai's household retinue crossing during David's flight
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ויעבר אתי הגתי וכל־אנשיו וכל־הטף אשר אתו
occurrences.working_translation: Ittai the Gittite crossed over with all his men and all the little ones who were with him
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones accompany a displaced military retinue rather than participate as combatants.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: a post-conquest civilian remnant placed under Gedaliah
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: הפקיד אתו אנשים ונשים וטף ומדלת הארץ מאשר לא־הגלו בבלה
occurrences.working_translation: [the king of Babylon] placed under him men, women, little ones, and some of the poorest of the land who had not been exiled to Babylon
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones belong to the non-exiled civilian remnant; displacement and remaining in the land dominate the setting.

occurrences.context_detail: civilians recovered from a political captor
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ונשים וטף וסרסים אשר השיב מגבעון
occurrences.working_translation: and women, little ones, and court officials whom he brought back from Gibeon
occurrences.classification_note: The repeated השיב describes recovery from Ishmael's captivity, so the earlier movement classification understated the conflict setting.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: the surviving population taken in the flight to Egypt
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: את־הגברים ואת־הנשים ואת־הטף ואת־בנות המלך ואת כל־הנפש אשר הניח נבוזראדן
occurrences.working_translation: the men, the women, the little ones, the king's daughters, and every person whom Nebuzaradan had left behind
occurrences.classification_note: Within Jeremiah 43:5–7 this enumerated remnant is taken to Egypt, making forced displacement the controlling episode.

occurrences.context_detail: visionary judgment against Jerusalem's population
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: זקן בחור ובתולה וטף ונשים תהרגו למשחית
occurrences.working_translation: old man, young man, young woman, little ones, and women—you shall kill them to destruction
occurrences.classification_note: The imperative תהרגו includes טף in the population exposed to visionary judgment.

occurrences.context_detail: the royal decree to annihilate the Jews
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: להשמיד להרג ולאבד את־כל־היהודים מנער ועד־זקן טף ונשים ביום אחד
occurrences.working_translation: to destroy, kill, and annihilate all the Jews, from youth to old man, little ones and women, in a single day
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones are explicitly included in the target population of the annihilation decree.

occurrences.context_detail: the counter-decree authorizing lethal defense and plunder
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: להקהל ולעמד על־נפשם להשמיד ולהרג ולאבד את־כל־חיל עם ומדינה הצרים אתם טף ונשים
occurrences.working_translation: to assemble and stand for their lives, and to destroy, kill, and annihilate every armed force of people or province attacking them, including little ones and women
occurrences.classification_note: Although להקהל occurs, this is armed mobilization. The syntax of הצרים אתם טף ונשים is disputed: the working translation includes little ones and women among those exposed to the counter-decree, while another reading takes them as the women and children of the Jews whom the armed force attacks. Either reading belongs in the conflict frame.

occurrences.context_frame: household movement, displacement, or protected residence
occurrences.context_detail: a fast seeking divine protection for a journey
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: לבקש ממנו דרך ישרה לנו ולטפנו ולכל־רכושנו
occurrences.working_translation: to seek from him a safe road for us, our little ones, and all our possessions
occurrences.classification_note: The requested דרך ישרה concerns safe travel for the full caravan, including the little ones.

occurrences.context_detail: the whole community standing before YHWH in crisis
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: וכל־יהודה עמדים לפני יהוה גם־טפם נשיהם ובניהם
occurrences.working_translation: all Judah was standing before YHWH, including their small children, their wives, and their sons
occurrences.classification_note: The little ones are present in a communal act of standing before YHWH; their distinction from בנים supports the narrower rendering 'small children'.

occurrences.context_detail: genealogical registration for cultic distributions
occurrences.relevant_hebrew_phrase: ולהתיחש בכל־טפם נשיהם ובניהם ובנותיהם לכל־קהל
occurrences.working_translation: and [the genealogical enrollment included] all their small children, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—the whole assembly
occurrences.classification_note: The governing infinitive להתיחש denotes genealogical enrollment, not attendance at an assembly; the frame records institutional inclusion in the cultic distribution system.
